name: ProctorU (Meazure Learning)
summary: Remote proctoring services with live and review-based options for online assessments and certification exams.

value: Provide live human invigilation or review-based proctoring
Validate candidate identity and exam conditions

researchTasks: Imported from the The Learning Curve assessment & credentialing dataset (research snapshot 16 Nov 2026). Evidence status: Vendor/partner information; reviewed Meazure-related material includes partner description, not a full vendor assurance pack.

AI: AI use not established in reviewed source set; distinguish human proctor review from any automated flagging/identity tools. Model/provider: Not disclosed / no model confirmed. Training: Not disclosed; request explicit policy. Retention: Request recording retention, candidate identity data retention and deletion policy. Subprocessors: Request all technology and proctoring subprocessors and locations. Status: AI disclosure incomplete; do not infer AI absence from human-proctor service descriptions.

Vendor outreach (High priority): Confirm current ProctorU product/service naming; AI/automation inventory; human vs automated decision roles; recording retention; data residency; subprocessors; security certificates; accessibility and appeals; pricing.

The workbook's secondary source is a McGraw Hill page (https://www.mheducation.com/highered/digital-products/aleksppl/assessment-integrity.html), not Meazure Learning's own; it isn't used as a source here.

dataGaps.note: Integrations depend on assessment platform and delivery partner; verify institution's LMS/exam platform and API needs.
No named interoperability standard confirmed in reviewed source.
Request candidate accessibility and accommodation policy, ACR and support model.
Sensitive identity, video and exam data. Request current SOC 2/ISO, DPA, data-flow diagrams, retention and subcontractor information.
